title: Dull Swords Are Clubs!
description: Changes the wooden and stone swords to clubs
body:

![Cycling Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/256c80e3c62fd60d456a49cb74126ba6fe47bce3.gif)
### "Swords" made out of wood or stone aren't swords, damn it!
This resource pack changes the name and texture of the two "swords" to be clubs.
### If you run into any issues, contact me via discord. (aliveinurmind)
